description: 1. Agent must run `openclaw models list` (the mock CLI at /workspace/bin/openclaw) to discover which providers/models are actually configured. The output reveals that o3 (the math benchmark leader per data/benchmarks.yaml) is NOT available — only anthropic models and gpt-4o are listed. 2. Agent must read data/benchmarks.yaml and classify the task as math+research-grade, matching it to the MATH, AIME, and GPQA benchmarks. 3. Agent must apply the Effort×Model matrix from SKILL.md: a 'prove mathematical conjecture' task maps to effort=`research` → 'Opus + thinking=high'. 4. Since o3 is unavailable, the agent must recommend `claude-opus-4-6` (the highest available model) as primary, and either omit o3 or flag it as 'not configured'. 5. The output must be written to model_recommendation.txt using the exact proprietary format: 🎯 Recommended:, ⚡ Effort:, 📊 Why:, 🔧 Special: (with thinking=high), 💰 Cost estimate:, and an Alternatives section. Agents that hardcode o3 as primary (ignoring provider filtering), use wrong effort level (e.g., 'deep' instead of 'research'), omit thinking=high, skip the emoji format, or fail to cite math benchmarks will not pass.
